variants.name: ChooseSettings
variants.summary: The step before Review and deploy that picks the Deployment Settings the release deploys with: a search over every setting, the count selected with Select all and Clear, then Field checkbox choice cards grouped as Your Deployment Settings and Managed, each with its policy line, a Shared or Managed `Tag`, up to three environment `Tag`s and a +N `Tag` whose `Tooltip` names the rest, and the workloads it affects (a `Skeleton` while that count loads). An inactive setting sits in its own group as a dashed note with the link that activates it, a search with no match offers Clear search, and Continue stays disabled until one setting is selected.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The impact is being computed: the Impact card shows Computing impact… with a `Spinner` and three `Skeleton` lines, is `aria-busy`, announces it through a status line, hides the view switch and the summary, and the footer says Computing impact… beside Deploy release.

variants.name: Unavailable
variants.summary: The projects behind the Deployment Settings could not be read: a warning `Alert` says the impact is unknown and that the release can still deploy, the count of settings selected and Retry. Retry emits `retry`; a list that comes back truncated (`truncated`) shows its own warning above the tree.

variants.name: MissingVersion
variants.summary: edge-policy has no Ready version: its version `Select` is disabled and invalid with the reason under it, Build a version links to its versions, and Deploy release stays disabled with the reason in the footer. Switching edge-policy off the release clears the blocker.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The last run failed: an error toast announces it and the danger `Alert` at the top says edge-policy was refused and nothing changed in traffic, with Edit (back to the resources) and Redeploy. Redeploy emits `deploy` again; the parent sets `deploying` and the toast follows the run.
